inference: Modes1/2 correctly price all emitted four-byte results on channel and PCIe without changing waves or source weights.
They are sensitivity cases, not bounds on every possible native output behavior.
Mode2 reading unused wave slots and both modes ignoring incomplete final accumulator require unverified semantics.
Small cost sensitivity does not validate native arbitrary-R execution, result framing or partial-output reconstruction.
The C++ interface is Qwen-specific: common upload320ns=2560/8, private upload80ns=640/8.
code_review: The Python adapter pairs jobs in GU-all then down-all creation order; our independent builder matches all480 saved graphs.
C++ emitted row formulas, per-result bandwidth and context release at channel drain match the independent specification.
Representative and additional negative-case event replay uses separate set-based ready queues, not the production scheduler/library.
Every node duration rises or stays fixed in the negative controls; altered greedy resource order explains lower isolated makespans.
